mapper.sql: LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ci.course_id, u.name AS instructor_name FROM tb_course_instructors ci JOIN tb_users u ON u.id = ci.user_id WHERE ci.instructor_role = 'MAIN' ) card_mi ON card_mi.course_id = c.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT course_id, COUNT(*) AS session_count FROM tb_course_sessions WHERE status <> 'CANCELLED' GROUP BY course_id ) card_sc ON card_sc.course_id = c.id

card_mi.instructor_name AS card_instructor_name, COALESCE(card_sc.session_count, 0) AS card_session_count, c.tags AS card_tags, c.tuition_type AS card_tuition_type, c.tuition_amount AS card_tuition_amount, c.thumbnail_file_id AS card_thumbnail_file_id
LEFT JOIN tb_institutions card_inst ON card_inst.id = c.institution_id

sql.if: AND ( LOWER(c.title) LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' ESCAPE '\' OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM tb_institutions kw_inst WHERE kw_inst.id = c.institution_id AND LOWER(kw_inst.name) LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' ESCAPE '\' ) OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM tb_course_instructors kw_ci JOIN tb_users kw_u ON kw_u.id = kw_ci.user_id WHERE kw_ci.course_id = c.id AND LOWER(kw_u.name) LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' ESCAPE '\' ) )
